issues.title: Enhanced lighting and level edits
issues.author: TheWhiteGuardian
issues.body:
Hi all! I'm seeing some strange behavior and I wanted to ask whether this is intended for now, or whether I'm doing something wrong. As a test I've made some placement edits to Novalis in Godot. I've saved the changes, packed them, and prepared them.
However this has broken enhanced lighting for me. I can open C:\Users\[Me]\OpenRAC\active\rac1\data\port\pal\level_01 and verify that water.bin and water.mesh exist, but they don't seem to be applied in-game. Oddly the log does read enhanced…
